explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 714 days after the shortage posting and subject to import alerts and warning letters

sentences.text: FDA first posted the azacitidine shortage on 2020-12-18 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21, spanning 70 months.
A registered plant for Accord Healthcare's product, Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004011473), received an OAI classification on 2022-12-02, 714 days after the shortage posting.
FDA issued an import alert (66-40) for Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited on 2023-06-01 and again on 2023-11-14, and warning letters on 2023-07-28 and 2023-11-21 for two Intas sites.
An alternate manufacturer option ranked by rule is BluePoint Laboratories, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses Sindan-Pharma Srl (last inspection NAI 2024-08-02).
P&T-approved interchange options include Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (approved 2026-04-04) and Accord Healthcare Inc. (approved 2025-09-24) as same-product alternates.

rejected.text: Multiple earlier inspections of Intas sites were classified VAI between 2019 and 2022, with classification letters issued 294 to 570 days before the shortage posting.

Q-a8ca13.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%azacitidine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%azacitidine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-1acdad.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('ff73515d-bd55-4eb5-992b-d2138c80887e', '70140e11-33f1-2240-e053-2991aa0a0480') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-bd4a69.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%azacitidine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-c8869f.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%azacitidine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-3f4fe4.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%azacitidine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-88f21b.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3004011473', '3003157498', '3002320821', '3005566806', '3006549835', '3012414462', '3011960448', '3009876430', '3008865184') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-8491c9.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3004011473', '3003157498', '3002320821', '3005566806', '3006549835', '3012414462', '3011960448', '3009876430', '3008865184') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-7f314d.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3004011473', '3003157498', '3002320821') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('intas', 'thymoorgan pharmazie')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-d5d4eb.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('intas', 'thymoorgan pharmazie', 'hikma', 'accord') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%azacitidine%' ORDER BY initiation_date
